# M.A.D for Business

> Venture studio and digital lab that designs, engineers and operates its own
> portfolio of software products: marketplaces, SaaS platforms and community
> apps. Registered as an LLC in Sheridan, Wyoming (USA), with its engineering
> team in Morocco. Five proprietary products are live today.

M.A.D for Business is not a classic development agency. It conceives, funds and
operates its own products, and partners with founders on custom platforms. All
products listed below were built and are run by the studio.

## Products

Each product has a dedicated page on this site describing how it works, who
it is for, and what it includes.

- [iDishYou](https://mad-for-business.vercel.app/products/idishyou): culinary
  marketplace connecting customers with verified home cooks nearby. No service
  fee for customers, AI photo ordering, QR code collection. Live at
  https://idishyou.com
- [Ravium](https://mad-for-business.vercel.app/products/ravium): festival app
  built on music matching, crew tracking and lineup clash detection. A separate
  product, Ravium Business, serves organisers. Live at
  https://ravium-462e9.web.app
- [SyndicHubs](https://mad-for-business.vercel.app/products/syndichubs):
  condominium management SaaS covering service charges, arrears, accounting,
  general meetings and incident triage, for professional and volunteer property
  managers. Live at https://syndichubs.com
- [SkoolHubs](https://mad-for-business.vercel.app/products/skoolhubs): school
  management SaaS for Morocco, complementary to Massar, connecting
  administrators, teachers, parents and students. Live at https://skoolhubs.org
- [ShowYourCause](https://mad-for-business.vercel.app/products/showyourcause):
  cause-driven clothing store where each design carries a message. Live at
  https://showyourcause.com

## Services

- Custom web and SaaS platform engineering (Next.js, TypeScript, cloud-native)
- Mobile and cross-platform application development
- Marketplace and two-sided platform architecture
- Venture building: product strategy, MVP delivery, scaling and operations

Services are described on the home page under the "Services" section.

## Pages importantes

- [Legal Notice](https://mad-for-business.vercel.app/legal): company name, legal
